OperatingRegime.description:
Commanded operating regime derived from PWM duty band or external label.

Values
------
LOW        : Motor running at low duty / speed band.
MEDIUM     : Motor running at medium duty / speed band.
HIGH       : Motor running at high duty / speed band.
TRANSITION : Motor is actively changing speed; steady-state features
             computed during this period are unreliable.
UNKNOWN    : Regime could not be determined from available signals.
OperatingRegime.title: OperatingRegime

QualityFlag.description:
Detailed reasons why a feature window may be INVALID or degraded.

Multiple flags may be set simultaneously.

Values
------
ACCEL_MISSING        : Accelerometer data absent for this window.
CURRENT_MISSING      : Current-sensor data absent for this window.
ENV_STALE            : Environmental sample is older than the
                       configured staleness threshold.
TIMESTAMP_GAP        : A discontinuity was detected in the sample
                       timestamps within the window.
INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLES : Fewer samples than the minimum required for
                       reliable feature extraction were available.
UNKNOWN_REGIME       : Operating regime could not be determined,
                       making regime-conditioned features unreliable.
QualityFlag.title: QualityFlag

WindowQuality.description:
Top-level quality classification of a feature window.

VALID   : All required features are present and plausible.
INVALID : One or more required features are absent, stale, or
          logically inconsistent.  Consumers must not use INVALID
          windows for inference without explicit handling.
WindowQuality.title: WindowQuality

description:
Pre-extracted feature vector over a contiguous time window.

This is the primary interface between the signal-processing pipeline
and the anomaly-detection / ML components.  It contains *already-
extracted* statistical and spectral features; no signal processing is
performed within this model.

Window quality
--------------
A window is VALID only when:
- ``accel_sample_count`` > 0 and all vibration features are present.
- ``current_sample_count`` > 0 and all current features are present.

A window is INVALID when any mandatory feature is absent.  Missing
values are represented as None; they must NOT be replaced with
fabricated zeros.

Environmental features
----------------------
Ambient temperature and humidity are *optional* in every window
because the DHT11 sampling interval (≥2 s) means environmental data
may be absent or stale for any given window.  ``environment_sample_age_ms``
indicates how old the most recent DHT11 reading was at window close.

Frequency-domain features
-------------------------
Band energies (low / high) represent the integral of the power
spectral density over defined frequency sub-bands, in g².  The exact
band boundaries are defined by the signal-processing component and
are documented there; this contract only validates the numeric
constraints.

accel_sample_count.description: Number of acceleration samples included in this window.
accel_sample_count.title: Accel Sample Count

ambient_humidity_pct.description: Most recent ambient relative humidity from the DHT11, in %.  Null when no environmental sample is available.
ambient_humidity_pct.title: Ambient Humidity Pct

ambient_temperature_c.description: Most recent ambient temperature reading from the DHT11, in °C.  Null when no environmental sample is available for this window.  This is NOT motor winding or housing temperature.
ambient_temperature_c.title: Ambient Temperature C

current_mean_a.description: Mean motor current over the window, in amperes.  May be signed (see CurrentSample.motor_current_a).
current_mean_a.title: Current Mean A

current_peak_a.description: Peak absolute motor current in the window, in amperes.  Non-negative.
current_peak_a.title: Current Peak A

current_sample_count.description: Number of current samples included in this window.
current_sample_count.title: Current Sample Count

current_std_a.description: Standard deviation of motor current over the window, in amperes.  Non-negative.
current_std_a.title: Current Std A

environment_sample_age_ms.description: Age of the most recent DHT11 reading at window close, in ms.  Null when no environmental sample is available.  Large values indicate a potentially stale environmental context.
environment_sample_age_ms.title: Environment Sample Age Ms

operating_regime.description: Operating regime classification at window close.

pwm_duty.description: Commanded PWM duty cycle in [0.0, 1.0] at window close.
pwm_duty.title: Pwm Duty

quality_flags.description: Detailed quality flags.  Empty list for fully VALID windows.  May contain multiple flags for INVALID or degraded windows.
quality_flags.title: Quality Flags

vibration_crest_factor.description: Crest factor = peak / RMS.  Non-negative.  A high crest factor may indicate impulsive events.
vibration_crest_factor.title: Vibration Crest Factor

vibration_high_band_energy_g2.description: Spectral energy in the high-frequency band, in g².  Non-negative.  Band boundaries defined by signal-processing layer.
vibration_high_band_energy_g2.title: Vibration High Band Energy G2

vibration_low_band_energy_g2.description: Spectral energy in the low-frequency band, in g².  Non-negative.  Band boundaries defined by signal-processing layer.
vibration_low_band_energy_g2.title: Vibration Low Band Energy G2

vibration_peak_g.description: Peak acceleration magnitude in the window, in g.  Non-negative.
vibration_peak_g.title: Vibration Peak G

vibration_rms_g.description: RMS of the acceleration magnitude vector, in g.  Non-negative.
vibration_rms_g.title: Vibration Rms G

vibration_std_g.description: Standard deviation of the acceleration magnitude, in g.  Non-negative.
vibration_std_g.title: Vibration Std G

window_end_us.description: Window end time in microseconds since run start.  Must be strictly greater than window_start_us.
window_end_us.title: Window End Us

window_quality.description: Top-level quality classification.  VALID windows must have all required features populated with positive sample counts.  INVALID windows may have null feature values.

window_start_us.description: Window start time in microseconds since run start.
window_start_us.title: Window Start Us
